test_cases.name: F24 regression: xref probe handles 200+ files khong fail ARG_MAX (V71-E01)
test_cases.description: Regression test cho F24 hotfix v7.0.1. Truoc fix: jq --argjson signals '$JSON' truyen JSON qua argv -> 'Argument list too long' khi tich luy >=100 signals (~140KB > ARG_MAX 128KB Linux). Sau fix: signals tich luy vao temp file + jq --slurpfile, KHONG dung argv. Eval phai chay duoc thuc te (executable test script kem theo, KHONG chi declarative).

input.scenario: Synthetic fixture 200 files .ts, moi file co unique orphan REQ-ID + FEAT-ID. Mock registry voi 1 feature impl_status=done (khong match code) -> trigger 1 coverage_gap + 200 orphan_annotation signals = 201 signals.

test_cases.validation: Test script (V71-E01) PHAI exit 0. Probe PHAI exit 0 KHONG 'Argument list too long'. Output JSON valid theo schema lane-signals-v1. signals[].dimension_id=QD1, signals[].fingerprint='sha256:...'. Cleanup tren EXIT trap. Idempotent — chay nhieu lan deu pass. F24 fix verified: scripts/wf-fix-probe-static-xref.sh:115-117 dung temp file + line 216 dung --slurpfile.

test_cases.name: D1 audit: orphan FEAT-ID khong duoc detect boi xref probe
test_cases.description: Phase 2 Code Trace D1: wf-fix-probe-static-xref.sh line 173 chi check orphan REQ-IDs voi $REQUIREMENTS_JSON, KHONG check orphan FEAT-IDs. File co FEAT-NONEXIST-X-001 trong code nhung khong co trong registry → silent miss. IMP-QD1-008 (P2): them FEAT-ID check vao probe.

input.scenario: Source file co annotation '// FEAT-ID: FEAT-NONEXIST-X-001' nhung registry KHONG co feature ID nay. REQ-ID khac dung hop le cung co mat.

expected.current_behavior: NO signal emitted — probe misses orphan FEAT-IDs (silent miss)

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD1-008: probe KHONG emit signal cho orphan FEAT-ID → regression confirmed. SAU IMP-QD1-008: phai emit signal voi signal_type='orphan_feat_annotation' va evidence.feat_id='FEAT-NONEXIST-X-001'. Fixture: fixtures/qd1-test/positive/pos-01 + expected-signals EXP-QD1-002.

test_cases.name: FN-003 audit: CTA locale bias — Vietnamese CTAs khong duoc detect
test_cases.description: Phase 1 FN-003: P-QD1-deep-ui-traversal hardcode danh sach CTA EN-only (Submit/Save/Create/Delete...). App Vietnamese co CTAs (Luu/Tao moi/Xoa/Cap nhat) → 100% miss. IMP-QD1-002 (P0): them VI CTA patterns hoac i18n-aware matching.

input.scenario: React component co buttons ['Luu', 'Tao moi', 'Xoa', 'Cap nhat'] nhung KHONG co English CTA nao. Profile=standard.

expected.current_behavior: NO cta_locale_skip signal — probe misses 100% Vietnamese CTAs
expected.false_positive_check: Component co English CTAs → KHONG emit false positive

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD1-002: probe KHONG emit signal cho VI CTAs → 100% miss app tieng Viet. SAU IMP-QD1-002: phai detect VI CTAs hoac emit warning 'i18n locale not configured'. Fixture: fixtures/qd1-test/positive/pos-05-vi-cta.tsx. expected-signals EXP-QD1-009.
test_cases.audit_ref: 02-qd1-functional-audit.md Phase 1 §5 FN-003 + Phase 2 AF-i18n-bias + expected-signals.json EXP-QD1-009
